items.title: Google's HEIR Aims to Make Homomorphic-Encrypted Inference a One-Click Capability
items.blurb: Google is introducing HEIR (Homomorphic Encryption Intermediate Representation), an open-source compiler and development toolchain designed to make encrypted computation easier to deploy.

items.title: DRAM Controller Register Manipulation Breaks CPU Memory Isolation
items.blurb: Security researcher Christopher Domas developed skitter-creek-bath-salts, an open-source hardware security tool that disrupts CPU privilege boundaries by manipulating memory controller translation registers.

items.title: Article: Rightsizing Platform Engineering: Building the Platform Your Organization Actually Needs
items.blurb: Shift-left and DevOps have impacted how we flow changes from inception to production, but at the cost of increased cognitive load and duplication of effort across testing, security, and maintenance.

items.title: Presentation: Prompt to Prod: Engineering an Autonomous SDLC at Scale
items.blurb: Andrew Swerdlow shares how Roblox scales autonomous software development from prompt to production.
